infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Click Tabs needs your location for Route Visits and EVV check-in and check-out.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Click Tabs needs photo access for your Electronic ID Badge and clinical documents.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Click Tabs requires camera access for taking patient ID badge photos and capturing clinical documentation.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Click Tabs to use your location for Route Visits and EVV check-in and check-out.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Click Tabs to access photos for your Electronic ID Badge and clinical documents.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Click Tabs to access the camera for ID badges and clinical documents.
